title: Beautiful 4BR 30A Vacation Home with a Shared Pool
meta_description: Sea Echo, a 4BR, 4.5BA 30A vacation home in SeaNest Village that backs up to a protected State Forest with walking trails. Includes a Shared Pool. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: Sea Echo is a beautiful home in SeaNest Village that backs up to a protected State forest offering privacy, walking trails, and beautiful views. Only a 4-minute walk to deeded beach access and a 30-second walk to the stunning community pool! The best location in the heart of Seagrove Beach close to great dining and shopping.This beach retreat is professionally decorated with serene earth tones that create a restful and relaxing space. There are 2 bedrooms on the 1st floor, 1 on the 2nd floor and another on the 3rd floor outside of an additional seating area. This home is as close to perfect as you can get.As you walk up to the 2nd floor, you are greeted with a large open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area. Off the living area there is a balcony with a commercial gas grill and forest views. You'll love this open area for spending some quality time with family and friends. Everyone can be a part of the action when you're entertaining here.Need more space? You can also rent this home together with its next door neighbor, Ocean Park. Just give us a call!Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 81st Floor, Bedroom 1: 2 twin beds, TV. Shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.1st Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV. Private bathroom with large shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with soaking tub and shower.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub, and shower.Beach Access:Exit out the neighborhood to 30A and cross the street to the bike path. Walk towards the right and you will see the gate at Sea Turtle Dr for your deeded beach access, utilizing the one security fob provided at the home.Distance: .2 miles | Time: 4 minutes walkingSeaNest Village:SeaNest Village is a gated community directly off 30A. This quaint neighborhood offers peace and privacy. The subdivision is bordered by Point Washington State Forest to the north. The community pool is breathtaking with its waterfall edge and cool blue tile. There is plenty of room to splash around on both levels. Relax on a lounger or at one of the cocktail tables. Head up to the observation deck to catch a great sunset.Your stay at Sea Echo comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars in driveway with passes; parking for additional 2 cars in garage.* Benchmark cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities* Please note, there is ongoing construction in this neighborhoodAn initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
